nature.mechanism: Evaporation, condensation, precipitation and flow transport water between reservoirs
nature.measured_quantity: Earth's oceans store approximately 96% of all water
nature.source_support: USGS water-cycle overview documents reservoirs, fluxes, and ocean share

human_body.mechanism: Water occupies intracellular and extracellular compartments; osmosis and renal regulation maintain balance
human_body.measured_quantity: Reference 70 kg adult male: approximately 42 L total body water (60% of body weight)
human_body.source_support: NCBI Bookshelf clinical physiology example gives 42 L for reference 70 kg adult male

pairs.interpretation: Both involve movement of H2O; their mechanisms, scales, and measurement definitions differ. This comparison does not establish a mystical equivalence.

unresolved: No verified equivalence between hydrologic and human regulatory systems
Other nature/body analogies require separate mechanisms and measurements
Creator's dark-matter claim is not established by these sources
